gloss: skin-beautifying effect; benefits for the skin

definitions.gloss: skin-beautifying effect; benefits for the skin
definitions.explanation: The effect of making skin smoother, clearer, or more attractive. A common marketing phrase for cosmetics, foods, and treatments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美肌効果|びはだこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This cream has a skin-beautifying effect.

examples.japanese: {美肌効果|びはだこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}できる→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧。
examples.english: Foods that can be expected to benefit the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美肌効果|びはだこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われ→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Hot springs are said to have a skin-beautifying effect and are popular with women.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美肌|びはだ}→美肌：14204_bihada⟧ (beautiful skin) and ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect). A frequent advertising term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美肌効果|びはだこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a skin-beautifying effect
- {美肌効果|びはだこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to be highly effective for the skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美容効果|びようこうか}: beauty effect — broader, covering hair, body, and overall appearance
